messages:
maya: ok team — Equinox webinar on June 9 is locked with partner. Need to align speakers, live demo plan, and swag/shipping deadlines. Can we do a short dry run Wed the week before?

emma: wed works for me. I can own run-of-show and slide handoff. who’s confirmed for talk slots?

maya: confirmed so far: Maya (partnerships) 5m intro, Equinox PM 12m product, Sanjay 15m integration demo, Chris 8m Q&A + fallback demo.

sanjay: adding note — demo has two modes: cloud-marketplace flow (hosted model via marketplace) and local HW fallback (partner's edge box). Need both to be automated in runbook.

chris: I can script the fallback. will push a container + tiny demo script. earliest I can have it ready is Mon June 3.

alex: swag timeline: need final art by May 20 to hit production. shipping cutoff May 29 for US fulfillment. budget ok?

kevin: sales will promote marketplace listing. can we get a short blurb (1-2 lines) + screenshot of the marketplace tile by May 25?

maya: timeline agreed. immediate asks: (1) eng: container + health-check endpoint for fallback; (2) events: run-of-show doc; (3) partner ops: courier details; (4) marketing: marketplace blurb + screenshot.

partnerops-bot: Reminder — equipment inventory form must be submitted 10 days before event. Link: https://intranet.redwood/equip-form

chris: putting container at registry.redwood.com/equinox-demo:v1. health check at /live. sample run command:
```
docker run -p 8080:8080 registry.redwood.com/equinox-demo:v1 
# then curl http://localhost:8080/live
```

sanjay: for marketplace flow, we need a short tokenized sample (no customer data). I’ll mock a prompt set and upload to demo org.

emma: run-of-show draft: 1) 5m intro, 2) 12m product, 3) 15m live integration demo, 4) 5m fallback demo, 5) 8m Q&A. Need final speaker slides by June 2. Sharing doc: https://docs.redwood/runofshow/equinox

alex: swag options: sticker pack + lanyards + 250x postcard cheat-sheets. Confirming vendor lead time. If we miss art deadline we can do postcard-only.

kevin: can marketing carve out a marketplace listing highlight — 1 tweet + 1 partner co-post. I’ll coordinate with PR.

maya: checklist for dry run Wed (June 5): - deploy marketplace demo flow; - start container fallback; - test video share + slide pass; - prod->staging fallback simulation; - run Q&A mic checks.

chris: confirmed. I’ll add health-check test in CI that hits /live and returns 200.

partnerops-bot: Logistics scheduled: courier pickup (NY) June 6 10:00am. Labeling template: https://intranet.redwood/labels.

emma: small ask — can engineering provide a 30s pre-recorded fallback clip as backup in case of live video issues?

chris: yes, will record and upload to shared drive by June 4.

maya: perfect. last thing — who’s on co-host controls during the webinar? I can do slides and chat, Emma you moderate Q&A?

emma: yes I’ll moderate. Sanjay you handle live demo chat questions.

kevin: pinging demand gen to add webinar to partner co-marketing calendar.

maya: great. if no objections I’ll lock dry run invite and vendor POs today. :thumbsup:

sanjay: :thumbsup: all good from my side.

alex: :+1: sending art brief now.

chris: :ok_hand:
